topic: Template Function with Trailing Return Type and SFINAE for Operator Overloading
explanation: This concept, operator-) for reverse iterators. It uses template parameters to accept different iterator types, employs a trailing return type with decltype to deduce the return type based on expressions involving template parameters, and leverages SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error) to enable or disable the function based on the validity of the expression. This approach allows writing generic, type-safe, and efficient operator overloads that adapt to various iterator types in modern C++.
